title: Do Not Forsake Me, O Lord

questions.question: O Lord, rebuke me not in your anger, nor discipline me in your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:1 (ESV): "O Lord, rebuke me not in your anger, nor discipline me in your wrath!"

questions.question: For your arrows have sunk into me, and your hand has come down on whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:2 (ESV): "...and your hand has come down on me."

questions.question: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation; there is no health in my bones because of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:3 (ESV): "...there is no health in my bones because of my sin."

questions.question: For my iniquities have gone over my head; like a heavy burden, they are too heavy for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:4 (ESV): "...they are too heavy for me."

questions.question: I confess my iniquity; I am sorry for my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:18 (ESV): "I confess my iniquity; I am sorry for my sin."

questions.question: My wounds stink and fester because of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:5 (ESV): "My wounds stink and fester because of my foolishness."

questions.question: I am utterly bowed down and prostrate; all the day I go about doing what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:6 (ESV): "...all the day I go about mourning."

questions.question: My heart throbs; my strength fails me, and the light of my eyes—it also has gone from whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:10 (ESV): "...and the light of my eyes—it also has gone from me."

questions.question: My friends and companions stand aloof from my plague, and my nearest kin stand where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:11 (ESV): "...and my nearest kin stand far off."

questions.question: But for you, O Lord, do I wait; it is you, O Lord my God, who will do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:15 (ESV): "...it is you, O Lord my God, who will answer."

questions.question: Those who are my foes without cause are mighty, and many are those who hate me how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:19 (ESV): "...and many are those who hate me wrongfully."

questions.question: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:22 (ESV): "Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation!"

questions.question: But I am like a deaf man; I do not hear, like a mute man who does not open his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:13 (ESV): "...like a mute man who does not open his mouth."

questions.question: For my sides are filled with burning, and there is no soundness in my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:7 (ESV): "...and there is no soundness in my flesh."

questions.question: O Lord, all my longing is before you; my sighing is not hidden from whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 38:9 (ESV): "...my sighing is not hidden from you."

key_verse_text: But for you, O Lord, do I wait; it is you, O Lord my God, who will answer.
